benchmark_type_evidence: we construct an evaluation set for XLU by extending the development and test sets of the Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference Corpus (MultiNLI) to 15 languages
brief_description: XNLI is a cross-lingual natural language inference evaluation corpus consisting of 7500 human-annotated development and test examples translated from English MultiNLI data into 14 other languages (15 total), covering three-way NLI classification (entailment, contradiction, neutral).
